canonical_packet.mapping_rule: For each of the 105 records in the original SHA256SUMS, original_path is the manifest path and restore_from is ORIGINAL-PACKET.zip!<original_path>; verify against that record's SHA-256.

source_provenance.rule: Each recovered-source/<local_path> is the exact Git blob named by the retained source manifest; repository_path, commit/ref, Git blob SHA-1 and SHA-256 are authoritative there. The direct archival copy reuses that same Git blob object.

omitted_from_direct_expansion: Other packet members are not duplicated as loose Git files; they remain byte-exact inside ORIGINAL-PACKET.zip and are individually covered by its original SHA256SUMS.
